primitives.name: Fielding Timing Optimization
primitives.verbatim_quote: The fielder must also bear in mind the fact that he should take the ball on the earliest good bound, and not, by waiting or backing away, make his throw necessarily a hurried one.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'t_{bound}': 'time of earliest good bound (s)', 't_{throw}': 'time of throw execution (s)', 'v_{throw}': 'throw velocity (m/s)'}
primitives.assumptions: Fielder's reaction time is bounded; delay in throw increases error probability.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When t_bound > t_throw, resulting in hurried throw with reduced accuracy.

layer2.mapping: GSE computes minimal time-to-throw path using kinematic constraints; GSI evaluates posterior probability of successful throw given timing uncertainty.
layer2.telemetry: Time between ball contact and throw release, measured in milliseconds.

primitives.name: Double Play Opportunity Recognition
primitives.verbatim_quote: There are times when good judgment leads a player to take the ball a little late; as, for instance, when he has an opportunity for a double-play with the ball coming directly at the base he wishes to cover.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'T_{play}': 'time window for double play (s)', 'B_{base}': 'base position vector (m)', 'v_{ball}': 'ball velocity vector (m/s)'}
primitives.assumptions: Player can predict ball path and base coverage dynamics.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure to recognize double-play opportunity due to delayed decision or misjudged ball trajectory.

layer2.mapping: GSE models double-play scenarios as multi-agent pursuit-evasion games; GSI uses probabilistic inference to assess likelihood of success.
layer2.telemetry: Success rate of double plays executed within T_play window.

primitives.name: Strategic Positioning for Throwing
primitives.verbatim_quote: Wherever it is practicable, a fielder should endeavor to take the ball in the most convenient position for immediate throwing to the quarter where the ball is most needed.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P_{position}': 'fielder position vector (m)', 'D_{target}': 'distance to target base (m)', 'v_{throw}': 'throw velocity (m/s)'}
primitives.assumptions: Throwing efficiency is maximized when fielder is optimally positioned relative to target.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Suboptimal positioning leads to longer throw paths and increased error margin.

layer2.mapping: GSE calculates minimum Euclidean path for throw; GSI evaluates conditional probability of throw success based on position and velocity.
layer2.telemetry: Distance from ball contact point to target base, measured in meters.
